summary: The customer complained that their personal loan interest rate increased to 18% after a promotional period ended. The agent explained the promotional rate ended on August 15th and provided a payoff amount of $8,420.50 through September 2nd, noting that early payoff waivers require verification. The customer asked for wire instructions and a formal payoff quote to be emailed today.
